when.quote: When a customer needs to file a dispute for a debit card transaction (unauthorized charges, ATM errors, merchant issues, or incorrect amounts), the agent must gather comprehensive information and follow Regulation E requirements.

starts.note:
customer: start only when the customer asks to dispute one or more debit card transactions. This includes a customer who denies a transaction during a review in another job (chip/CVV mismatch, fraud alert, or the PIN lock investigation's check on a card that cannot be unlocked) and agrees to dispute it.

File one dispute per transaction. The card actions the dispute procedure maps from the filed categories are required. A dispute that is held back or dropped sets no card action.

If the customer asks for a human agent, offer to help first, and transfer only on the 4th request.

steps.do:
Check each existing in-progress dispute against its filing_date:
- Provisional credit within 10 days (20 for new accounts, open less than 30 days). Check this only for disputes whose dispute_category is unauthorized_transaction, card_present_fraud, card_not_present_fraud, atm_cash_discrepancy or duplicate_charge. Such a dispute is late if provisional_credit_issued is false and more days than that have passed up to now (get_time), or if provisional_credit_date fell later than that. A goods_services_not_received, recurring_charge_after_cancellation, atm_deposit_not_credited or incorrect_amount dispute without credit is not late on credit.
- Investigation within 45 days (90 for international/POS), for disputes still OPEN, PENDING_DOCUMENTATION or PROVISIONAL_CREDIT_ISSUED.
Do not check resolved or closed disputes. If a dispute is past either timeline, tell the customer and offer escalation to a supervisor. Transfer only if they agree.

steps.do:
Place each report against the statement that first showed the transaction, never the transaction date. What the records bound:
- A statement comes after its transactions. So a report within 60 days (or 2 business days) of the transaction is also within 60 days (or 2 business days) of the statement.
- A statement the customer was reviewing is dated on or before discovery_date. So a report more than 2 business days after that date is past the 2-business-day window.
If the report is past 2 business days but within 60 days, tell the customer their maximum liability is $500 and that any provisional credit is reduced by it.
If the tier cannot be settled, explain all three tiers and do not pick one.

rules.quote: They have 10 business days to sign and return it

rules.rule: Only an ACTIVE card can be frozen
rules.quote: Card must currently be in ACTIVE status (cannot freeze PENDING, CLOSED, or already FROZEN cards)

rules.rule: Fraud over $500: ask about a police report, and recommend one if none was filed
rules.quote: For fraud disputes over $500, ask if customer has filed a police report. If not, recommend they do so.

rules.rule: File the dispute for past recurring charges first; a block on future charges comes after, and only if the customer wants it
rules.quote: 1. First file the dispute for past charges

rules.rule: Pending transactions block a card closure
rules.quote: 4. No pending transactions: The card must not have any pending or processing transactions.

rules.rule: An Entry-tier replacement waits 48 hours after closure
rules.quote: 48-hour waiting period after card closure before a replacement can be ordered

rules.rule: Escalate an existing dispute that is past its timeline
rules.quote: If a dispute appears to be exceeding timelines, escalate to a supervisor.

rules.rule: File each transaction under its own transaction_id
rules.quote: ID of the transaction being disputed. Use get_bank_account_transactions_9173 to find it.

rules.rule: A PIN-locked card with no successful unauthorized transactions gets no dispute
rules.quote: If no unauthorized transactions: Explain the security concern and offer options:

rules.rule: An unvalidated Rho-Bank ATM claim may still be filed, or dropped
rules.quote: If journal shows correct amount dispensed, inform customer the claim cannot be validated but they may still file a formal dispute

rules.rule: customer_max_liability_amount is the doc 031 tier capped at the amount, or -1 for unlimited
rules.quote: Reported after 60 days: Unlimited liability - customer may not recover funds

done_when: The customer is verified and the verification is logged (once per conversation). Every requested dispute that passes the pre-filing rules and fits the account's open-dispute limit is filed, one per transaction_id, with every parameter decided by its rule. Disputes held back or dropped were explained to the customer and set no card action. Each card's most severe action among its filed disputes was performed once, after the last dispute. Fraud alerts on cards with a denied transaction were not cleared. Lost or stolen cards were handed off to the cross-product check. The customer has a summary of liability, provisional credit, timelines, any affidavit, and card status. A PIN-locked card with only declined attempts had no dispute filed. Any failure was explained, and a transfer was offered. A transfer the customer requested happened only on the 4th request.
